name: Morse.IsComplexSubmanifold
why: Both say every tangent space of N is J-invariant, for an arbitrary continuous linear J (neither imposes J^2 = -1); the project's tangent space is Morse.tangentSubspace (range of mfderiv val), the blind one the span of velocities, and these are equal for every slice submanifold. 'forall x : N' vs 'forall x in N' is cosmetic. Both use the J-invariance characterisation of complex submanifolds rather than holomorphic charts (the description's own definition).
